decisions.reason: Turnaround management sits close to the core offer, has its own page and underpins the integrated data-driven strategy, so the option remains valuable and cheap to hold.
The connectivity module is still only mentioned, but it is a low-cost add-on to the installed base whose value in integrated apron solutions has not yet resolved under long airport sales cycles.

Billing software is the furthest from the operational core and shows little prominence, but its maintenance cost is low and two years is still limited evidence, so the option is kept while being watched closely.
Equipment monitoring feeds the service and maintenance business on the installed base, so keeping this inexpensive option open remains justified.
The controller safety alert service extends the tower offer, and air navigation procurement cycles are too long for its value to be judged yet, so the option stays open.
